selection_method: Refreshed top-1,000 ranked queue; selected bodies <=250 lines with >=3 already-understood non-generic semantic direct callees and >=2 indexed callers. Five workers x 7–8; QA checked every name and one blank per batch, launched as producers completed.
notes: QA rejected one broad player-specific name because its body did not support a player-only role; another was corrected to dispatch_state_callback_if_allowed.
Only 7 of 38 targets yielded names, so stop using the >=3 callee/2 caller filter as a batch recipe.
No prototype or field evidence was proposed.
Token use cannot be quantified; GPT-6 Luna low was explicitly selected.
